svg.title: What It Costs to Know What You Own
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-research-tool-costs; chapter number: 2; title: What It Costs to Know What You Own; subtitle: State data paywalls, well software, consultants, landmen and title searches; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: US dollars at the quoted billing basis; bars: label: North Dakota DMR Basic; min: 50; max: 50; typical: 50; display: $50 per year; label: WellDatabase Essential plan; min: 250; max: 250; typical: 250; display: $250 per month per user, up to 10,000 wells exported; label: Landman day rate; min: 600; max: 600; typical: 600; display: About $600 per day; label: Decline-curve consultant replaced; min: 600; max: 800; typical: 600; display: $600 to $800; label: Limited title search; min: 3000; max: 3000; typical: 3000; display: About $3,000 and roughly one week; caption: Sands paid one month of WellDatabase Essential for decline curve work, downgraded to free, and replaced a $600 to $800 consultant.; assumptions note: Billing bases differ (per year, per month, per day, per job) and are not normalized. Where only a range was quoted, typical is set at the low end.; note: Attributed to Matt Sands (u4xA0UNrxQs, EDD6HaFdEzE, 1HDBzjGoDdc) on YouTube.
